issues: The [act] [cost00] ability is encoded as a generic playCostReduction on this card; it should grant cost reduction only to the next Loot card you play this turn, e.g. use grantNextPlayCostReduction with a Loot filter and amount 2.
The [act] [cost00] ability is marked oncePerTurn: true, but the source says 'Activate only twice per turn'; remove oncePerTurn and keep maxPerTurn: 2.

The second [act] ability is incorrectly set to activateFrom: 'cemetery' with banishSelf cost; it should be an activated ability from the field whose cost banishes an 'Octrice, Omen of Usurpation' from your cemetery.
The second [act] ability only creates Gilded Blade; it should let you choose one of Gilded Blade, Gilded Goblet, or Gilded Boots and put the chosen token into your EX area.

The base card is missing the alternate [evolve] [cost00] ability conditioned on there being at least 10 cards in opponents' cemeteries; add an evolve-timing ability or equivalent evolve cost line with condition opponentCemeteryMin 10 and cost 0.

The [act] [cost08] ability uses playFromOpponentCemetery with filter.cardType 'card', which is invalid; encode it as selecting any card in an opponent's cemetery for play for 0 PP without the invalid cardType field.
On Evolve is encoded with tutorFromCemetery, which refers to your cemetery; it should select a card in an opponent's cemetery and put it into your EX area.

The passive cost reduction is encoded as a generic playCostReduction on this card; it should reduce the cost of any card you play from the EX area by 2 while the opponentCemeteryMin 10 condition holds, not reduce this card's own play cost.

Both fanfare and Last Words use buffFieldTrait without a filter, which would affect only followers on your field but not necessarily 'each other follower'/'each follower' exactly as intended across all followers; they should apply +0/+2 to all your followers (excluding self on fanfare, including self on Last Words) plus heal your leader 2. Implement an ability to buff all allied followers, or extend buffFieldTrait/targeting to support all allied followers regardless of trait.
